instruction.text: Kathy lebt seit 2 Wochen im Internat. Nun telefoniert sie mit ihrem Vater, um ihre ersten Erfahrungen zu teilen. Ergänze den Dialog.

atoms.b: Hi dear! How are you doing?
atoms.sound: Hi dear! How are you doing?

atoms.b: Hello Dad! Everything's great. I only ((++felt have_felt)) a little homesick last week.
atoms.sound: Hello Dad! Everything's great. I only felt a little homesick last week.

atoms.b: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear. Are you feeling better now?
atoms.sound: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear. Are you feeling better now?

atoms.b: Yes, I ((++have_been was)) fine recently, don't worry!
atoms.sound: Yes, I have been fine recently, don't worry!

atoms.b: That's good to hear! How did your first weeks at school go?
atoms.sound: That's good to hear! How did your first weeks at school go?

atoms.b: Cool! Do you like your teachers?
atoms.sound: Cool! Do you like your teachers?

atoms.b: Our house teacher ((++seemed has_seemed)) a little strict on the first day, but she ((++has_been was)) very helpful to me since then.
atoms.sound: Our house teacher seemed a little strict on the first day, but she has been very helpful to me since then.

atoms.b: And how about the other pupils?
atoms.sound: And how about the other pupils?

atoms.b: Not bad! I ((++have_made made)) two friends already.
atoms.sound: Not bad! I have made two friends already.

atoms.b: Sheila is my roommate, which is why I ((++have_known knew)) her since I moved in. On the first day of school, we ((++found_out have_found_out)) that we are both playing in the school orchestra.
atoms.sound: Sheila is my roommate, which is why I have known her since I moved in. On the first day of school, we found out that we are both playing in the school orchestra.

atoms.b: Sheila ((++introduced has_introduced)) me to her best friend Max two days ago. Since then, the three of us ((++have_been were)) together all the time.
atoms.sound: Sheila introduced me to her best friend Max two days ago. Since then, the three of us have been together all the time.

atoms.b: Kathy, I'm very happy to hear all about your new life.
atoms.sound: Kathy, I'm very happy to hear all about your new life.

atoms.b: Yes, everything is so exciting at the moment, but I'm looking forward to Christmas holiday already.
atoms.sound: Yes, everything is so exciting at the moment, but I'm looking forward to Christmas holiday already.

atoms.b: Me too, my dear. Have a nice evening! I will call you again soon.
atoms.sound: Me too, my dear. Have a nice evening! I will call you again soon.
